pilot: zebrafish (Danio rerio) -- extant species, states measured from UniProt, not inferred

claim_boundary.protein_state_gives_you: Which molecular species actually diffuses (mature/signalling chain after signal-peptide and proprotein cleavage, not the precursor), a RELATIVE diffusion ranking D_rel ~ MW^(-1/3) between those species, and qualitative membrane tethering when lipidation is annotated (ShhNp: N-palmitate + C-cholesterol).
claim_boundary.protein_state_does_not_give_you: Absolute diffusion coefficients, production/degradation rates, Her1 half-life or segmentation-clock period, wavefront speed, receptor affinities. Those are kinetic facts for the cited literature / ZFIN, labelled literature_required below.
claim_boundary.therefore: Every morphospace prediction here is DIRECTIONAL or a ratio under a stated held-fixed assumption (e.g. lambda ~ sqrt(D/k) at fixed k), never an absolute fit.

protein_states.why: her1 is the somitogenesis segmentation-clock oscillator - pairs with clock-wavefront models rather than steady Turing patterns.

protein_state.source: UniProtKB feature table + comments (live REST, not hand-copied)

diffusible_species.note: Nuclear bHLH transcriptional repressor (UniProt location: Nucleus). Intracellular oscillator, not a diffusible morphogen; D_rel is not defined for it.

protein_states.why: Fgf8a (acerebellar): midbrain-hindbrain organiser gradient; classic Wolpert positional-information morphogen.

protein_state.source: UniProtKB feature table + comments (live REST, not hand-copied)
function_comments: Plays an important role in the regulation of embryonic development, cell proliferation, cell differentiation and cell migration (By similarity). Required for Kupffer's vesicle ciliogenesis (PubMed:19164561)

her1_state_moves.parameter: T_clock (period), via Her/Hes autorepression delay + protein/mRNA degradation
her1_state_moves.captured_from_uniprot: Identity, 328 aa nuclear bHLH repressor, domains (bHLH 12-69, Orange 118-152). No modified-residue / degradation annotation in UniProt.
her1_state_moves.literature_required: Her1 half-life, transcriptional/translational delays, and the resulting ~30 min zebrafish clock period must come from the somitogenesis literature / ZFIN, not from sequence or UniProt state.

fgf8a_state_moves.parameter: u (wavefront position/speed), via the posterior FGF gradient cells exit as it regresses

worked_sensitivity.formula: dS/S = dT/T at fixed u (equivalently dS/S = du/u at fixed T)
worked_sensitivity.reading: A protein-state change that altered Her1 degradation would move somite length in direct proportion to the period change -- but the size of that period change is literature_required, so no numeric S prediction is claimed here.
